name: zsnd_sample_set_registry_add_entry
description: zSndSampleSet::RegistryAddEntry initializes a sample-set record, allocates samples, duplicates the optional name, and appends the record to the global sample-set registry.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification was attempted with vc5_o2_ob2_facs and failed: after restoring RegistryAppend as an inline helper, the compiled function is 240 bytes versus the 536-byte original with 476 unmasked differences. The remaining mismatch is the original's fuller std::vector-style insert/relocation code shape versus the current source-level push-back helper.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4a09e0 validates calloc(sampleCount, sizeof(zSndSample)), assigning sampleCount and resourcesLoaded, duplicating non-null setName with _strdup, appending self into the global registry vector, growing vector capacity when no slot is available, and returning self.

The native smoke verifies a named two-sample entry and a null-name one-sample entry, including zeroed sample allocation, resourcesLoaded reset, setName duplication/null behavior, returned self pointer, registry begin/end/capacity updates, and appended entry order.
